zh.title: 阿聯酋航空三週後恢復休士頓17小時空中巴士A380不停站航線
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空三週後恢復休士頓空中巴士A380不停站航線
body: Simple Flying報導，阿聯酋航空將在三週後恢復休士頓的空中巴士A380航班。報導標題將這條不停站航線描述為17小時；摘要則指出，阿聯酋航空將恢復休士頓的A380航班服務。
報導摘要也提到阿聯酋航空載客率下滑、需求轉弱，以及整體航網運能縮減。這些情況與休士頓航線恢復一併出現在摘要中；報導所述的服務將於三週後恢復，機型為空中巴士A380，航線則是不停站飛行。

en.title: Emirates to Restore 17-Hour Nonstop A380 Service to Houston in Three Weeks
en.summary: Emirates is set to restore 17-hour nonstop Airbus A380 service to Houston in three weeks.
body: Simple Flying reports that Emirates will restore Airbus A380 flights to Houston in three weeks. The headline describes the nonstop route as a 17-hour service, while the summary identifies the Houston flights as a restoration.

The summary also cites declining load factors, weaker demand and wider network capacity reductions. It presents these conditions alongside Emirates' planned return to Houston, with the restored service identified as Airbus A380 flights due in three weeks. The reported route is nonstop and is described as lasting 17 hours.

zh.title: 空中巴士預測航空公司至2045年需新增240萬名員工
zh.summary: 空中巴士預測航空公司至2045年需新增240萬名員工。
body: 空中巴士表示，航空公司到2045年將需要新增240萬名工作人員。Simple Flying標題也稱，航空服務業規模將倍增，將這項人力需求與服務業的預期變化並列呈現。
Simple Flying摘要指出，未來二十年旅客人數將倍增，航空業也將需要新增100萬名客艙組員以支應產業成長。摘要把客運成長與客艙組員需求一併列為航空業未來需求展望。

en.summary: Airbus says airlines will need 2.4 million new workers by 2045.
body: Airbus says airlines will need 2.4 million new workers by 2045. The Simple Flying headline also says the aviation services sector will double, placing the workforce projection alongside the sector outlook.

Simple Flying's summary says passenger numbers will double over the coming two decades. It adds that one million new cabin crew members will be required to support industry growth. The summary presents passenger growth and cabin-crew demand as part of the aviation industry's future workforce outlook.

zh.title: 空中巴士預測航空服務市場至2045年將倍增
zh.summary: 空中巴士預測航空服務需求至2045年將倍增，市場規模逾4,200億美元
body: 空中巴士預測，全球航空服務需求將自2026年起逐步成長，至2045年倍增，屆時市場規模估計超過4,200億美元。這項預測涵蓋航空服務市場，並非單一服務類別的估值。
空中巴士預估，未來累計將需要73萬名維修技術人員、66萬名飛行員及105萬名客艙組員，合計新增技能人力需求超過244萬人。這些數字呈現預測期間內各類航空職務的人力需求。
在服務類別方面，空中巴士估計，機外維修市場至2045年將達2,170億美元，年複合成長率為3.7%；公司將其成長與全球機隊擴大及老化、進廠維修次數增加相連結。維修營運支援則是新增的服務類別，2045年市場估值為1,040億美元，年複合成長率為4.3%，內容包括庫存供應及工程支援。
空中巴士預測，數位與連線服務是成長最快的市場類別，至2045年估值為270億美元，並將在未來二十年增至目前的三倍。就地區而言，歐洲與獨立國協、北美及中國預計仍是總需求最大的市場；亞洲（亞太、中國及南亞）則預計成長最快。這些均為空中巴士對全球航空服務市場的預測。

en.title: Airbus Forecasts Aviation Services Market to Double by 2045
en.summary: Airbus forecasts aviation services demand will double by 2045, exceeding US$420 billion.
body: Airbus forecasts that total demand for aviation services will double from 2026, reaching an estimated value of more than US$420 billion by 2045. The projection covers the aviation services market as a whole, rather than a single service segment.

The company estimates that the industry will cumulatively need 730,000 maintenance technicians, 660,000 pilots and 1,050,000 cabin crew over the period. Together, those roles amount to a projected need for more than 2.44 million additional skilled people. These are workforce requirements in Airbus’ forecast, not reported current vacancies.

Among the service categories, Airbus estimates that off-wing maintenance will reach US$217 billion by 2045, with a 3.7% compound annual growth rate. It attributes the segment’s projected increase to a growing and ageing global fleet and more shop visits. Maintenance operations support, a newly added cluster that includes inventory provision and engineering support, is forecast to reach US$104 billion, with a 4.3% compound annual growth rate.

Digital and connectivity is identified as the fastest-growing market segment, with a projected value of US$27 billion by 2045 and an expected tripling over the next two decades. Airbus also forecasts that Europe and CIS, North America and China will remain the largest services markets by total demand. Asia, defined in the forecast as Asia-Pacific, China and South Asia, is projected to grow fastest. These figures and regional comparisons are Airbus forecasts for the aviation services market.

zh.title: 日本航空訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2 取代J-AIR E170與E190機隊
zh.summary: 日本航空訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2，取代J-AIR現有機隊。
body: 日本航空（JAL）於2026年10月14日宣佈，已訂購最多26架巴西航空工業E190-E2，以取代旗下區域航空公司J-AIR的區域客機機隊。訂單包括16架確定訂購的飛機及10架選擇權，預計於2029會計年度開始交付。
這批E190-E2將接替J-AIR目前使用的巴西航空工業E170與E190。J-AIR以大阪國際機場（ITM）為主要樞紐，營運遍及日本的噴射客機航班，北至北海道女滿別，南至鹿兒島縣奄美羣島。
日本航空表示，這項決定是其國內營運調整的一環；該公司稱，E190-E2是J-AIR相關計畫的核心機型。

en.title: Japan Airlines orders up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 jets for J-AIR fleet replacement
en.summary: Japan Airlines ordered up to 26 E190-E2 jets to replace J-AIR’s regional fleet.
body: Japan Airlines (JAL) announced on October 14, 2026, that it has ordered up to 26 Embraer E190-E2 aircraft to replace the regional jet fleet of its subsidiary J-AIR. The order includes 16 firm aircraft and 10 options, with deliveries scheduled to begin in fiscal year 2029.

The E190-E2s will succeed J-AIR’s current Embraer E170 and E190 aircraft. J-AIR operates jet flights across Japan from its main hub at Osaka International Airport (ITM), from Memanbetsu in Hokkaido in the north to the Amami Islands in Kagoshima Prefecture in the south.
JAL said the decision is part of wider changes to its domestic operations and called the E190-E2 a core part of its plan for J-AIR.

zh.title: 英國航空今冬將以波音787執飛倫敦希斯洛至馬德里航線
zh.summary: 英國航空今冬將以波音787執飛倫敦希斯洛至馬德里巴拉哈斯短程航線。
body: 英國航空將於今年冬季在倫敦希斯洛至馬德里巴拉哈斯的短程航線使用波音787客機。報導摘要指出，倫敦希斯洛是英國航空的主要樞紐，馬德里則是西班牙首都。
摘要將馬德里描述為英國航空的重要短程航點，原因是該市是寰宇一家合作夥伴 Iberia 的所在地。Simple Flying 的標題另稱，英國航空推出從 Heathrow 出發、飛行時間為兩小時的波音787航班。

en.title: British Airways to Use Boeing 787 on Heathrow–Madrid Route This Winter
en.summary: British Airways will use Boeing 787s on its Heathrow–Madrid short-haul route this winter.
body: British Airways will fly the Boeing 787 on its short-haul route from its main hub at London Heathrow (LHR) to Madrid–Barajas this winter, according to Simple Flying’s summary. The summary identifies Madrid as Spain’s capital and describes it as a key short-haul route for the airline because it is home to oneworld partner Iberia.
Separately, Simple Flying’s headline describes new two-hour Boeing 787 flights from Heathrow. The summary presents the aircraft’s use on the London Heathrow–Madrid route as a winter operation.

zh.title: Horizon Air機師指控資方企業貪婪 於西雅圖與波伊西發動糾察
zh.summary: Horizon Air機師指控資方管理不善與企業貪婪；10月14日在西雅圖與波伊西舉行資訊性糾察，要求資方結束拖延並達成公平合約。
body: Horizon Air機師指控僱主展現「管理不善與企業貪婪的模式」，並表示這已影響薪資與工作條件的協商。
代表這批機師的Teamsters Local 1224表示，約650名機師將於2026年10月14日舉行資訊性糾察，呼籲航空公司「結束拖延戰術，並同意一份公平的合約」。
根據Teamsters於2026年10月13日發布的聲明，這批近650名機師「為一份處理薪資、人力與訓練短缺及營運問題的團體協約，已爭取近四年」。
機師們不滿姊妹航空公司阿拉斯加航空的同仁執飛時數幾乎相同，「薪資卻仍落後業界標準」，並將此歸因於公司「不願協商公平的協議」。
Teamsters Local 1224的聲明指出：「Horizon Air已展現出影響協商過程的管理不善與企業貪婪模式。」
資訊性糾察預定於當地時間10時30分起，在西雅圖-塔科馬國際機場（SEA）與波伊西機場（BOI）舉行。
Horizon Air每日飛航近50個目的地，主要於美國西部為阿拉斯加航空的航網提供轉運。Teamsters Local 1224在2026年2月曾表示：「現在不是作秀或搏版面的時候。這關乎問責與實質改變。」

en.title: Horizon Air pilots accuse employer of 'corporate greed' as staff hold picket
en.summary: Horizon Air pilots accuse employer of mismanagement and corporate greed; informational picket set for October 14 at Seattle-Tacoma and Boise airports.
body: Horizon Air pilots have accused their employer of showing a "pattern of mismanagement and corporate greed" that has affected negotiations over wages and conditions.
The pilots, represented by Teamsters Local 1224, will hold an informational picket on October 14, 2026, calling on the airline to "end its delay tactics and agree to a fair contract".

A Teamsters statement on October 13, 2026, said a group of nearly 650 pilots has been "fighting for a collective bargaining agreement that addresses wages, staffing and training shortages, and operational issues for nearly four years".

The pilots are unhappy that colleagues at sister carrier Alaska Airlines perform nearly the same amount of flying "yet their wages remain behind industry standard", which the union attributes to the company's "unwillingness to bargain a fair deal".
The informational picket is due to be held at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA) and Boise Airport (BOI) from 10:30, local time.

Horizon Air operates daily flights to nearly 50 destinations, largely feeding Alaska Airlines' network in the western United States. In February 2026, Teamsters Local 1224 said: "This is not about theatrics or headlines. It is about accountability and meaningful change."
